info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Counterparty Management API
info.description: The Counterparty Management API enables efficient updates to counterparty information within the banking market data framework. This API facilitates modifications to existing counterparty records, ensuring that vital data remains accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers include financial institutions and market analysts who rely on precise counterparty details for compliance and risk assessment. The API streamlines data maintenance processes, thereby enhancing operational efficiency and supporting informed decision-making.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific counterparty identified by PARTY-600045 in the market data system. Make sure to provide the necessary changes in the request body to modify the counterparty information accurately.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a specific counterparty identified by PARTY-600045. The payload must comply with the schema defined for this operation, which specifies the required and optional fields that can be included to modify the counterparty's information.
